name: Smith Machine Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Set the bar of a Smith machine at about the middle of your thighs.
Stand close to the bar with your feet hip width apart and hold it with an overhand grip just outside your thighs.
Rotate the bar to unhook it and stand tall with your shoulders back.
Keep a small bend in your knees and push your hips back. Slide the bar down your thighs and keep your back flat.
Stop when you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings, near the middle of your shins. Do not let the bar touch the floor.
Push your hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes. Repeat, then rotate the bar to hook it.
